WITH race_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    cr.raceId,
    c.country,
    COUNT(*) as entry_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(cr.points), 0) as total_points
  FROM constructorResults cr
  JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY cr.raceId, c.country
),
avg_entries AS (
  SELECT AVG(entry_count) as avg_count
  FROM race_stats
)
SELECT 
  rs.raceId,
  rs.country,
  rs.total_points,
  rs.entry_count,
  rs.entry_count - ae.avg_count as diff_from_avg
FROM race_stats rs
CROSS JOIN avg_entries ae
WHERE rs.entry_count > ae.avg_count
ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
